card.name: Words right before a stated quantity or range
card.fires_on: Small words or number-units just before a value, range or definition is spelled out, such as 'to' after a weight, 'the' before smaller/larger, or 'means' after a code number. Seen in dose tables and technical explanations.

modes.label: Weight and range bands
modes.description: Linking word or unit between bounds of a weight or dose band in a dosing table.

modes.label: Explaining a coded value
modes.description: Verb or word that introduces what a number or term stands for or equals.

modes.label: Arithmetic and splitting
modes.description: Word within a step or split that points to the next quantity.
